title: Schedule of Notice, Post-Death Fee and Final Statement Periods (Independent Living)
content:
This schedule to the Independent Living Residency Agreement sets the periods, in calendar days, that apply when a residency ends.

| Apartment type | Resident's notice period of termination | Shortened notice period for a move to Larkspur assisted living or memory care | Days after the date of death of the last occupant through which monthly fees continue | Days after the vacate date by which the final statement is issued |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 30 | 7 | 14 | 30 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 30 | 7 | 14 | 30 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 30 | 7 | 14 | 30 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 30 | 7 | 14 | 30 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 30 | 7 | 14 | 30 |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 60 | 14 | 30 | 30 |

## Meaning of each period

1. **Resident's notice period of termination** — the length of the resident's written notice of termination, in calendar days counted from the notice date.
2. **Shortened notice period** — the shortened notice period that applies when the resident leaves the apartment for a Larkspur assisted living or memory care residence, in calendar days counted from the notice date.
3. **Post-death fee days** — the number of calendar days after the date of death of the last occupant through which monthly fees continue, unless belongings are removed later.
4. **Final statement days** — the number of calendar days after the vacate date by which the final statement is issued and any credit balance is refunded.

## Points of comparison

- The Independent Living Cottage Home carries the longer periods: 60 days of notice, 14 days for a move to Larkspur assisted living or memory care, and 30 post-death fee days.
- Every other apartment type carries 30 days of notice, 7 days for such a move, and 14 post-death fee days.
- The final statement period is 30 days for every apartment type.

Hypothetical illustration: for an Independent Living One-Bedroom whose notice is dated on a given day, the end of a 30-day notice period falls on the date 30 calendar days after the notice date.
